content.title: 'The Pitt' Season 2 Finale to Screen Early at Alamo Drafthouse
content.text: Sign in to confirm you’re not a bot This helps protect our community. Learn more Fans of the hit medical drama “The Pitt” will be able to watch the finale for the second season in movie theaters as part of a special healthcare appreciation event with free admission at Alamo Drafthouse theaters.
